name_reason: Follows data_fd2_battle_* convention; accurately names the enemy-AI selected inventory slot index for the best offensive item. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching its own/another data address). 'slot' reflects the unsigned slot-index datatype. Parallel to the verified sibling data_fd2_battle_ai_best_spell_slot.
purpose: Enemy-AI item-use selection: holds the inventory slot index of the best offensive item chosen during AI scoring; consumed when the AI executes the item-use action.
logic_summary: Last member of the C33/C37/C3B/C3F best-item cluster (score / target_x / target_y / slot). fd2_ai_score_item_use iterates the caster's usable inventory slots x reachable target tiles, scores each offensive-item candidate, and on a new best (iVar6 > ai_best_item_score) atomically updates score(C33), target_x(C37), target_y(C3B) and this slot(C3F) to the winning loop counter slot_iter (writer @0x15823: MOV [0x53C3F],EAX). fd2_execute_ai_item_use then reads this slot to resolve the item id (@0x1507C -> fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id) and to apply the effect (@0x152E9 -> fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch).
element_semantics: Single uint32 scalar = inventory slot index (0-based loop counter into caster.pInventory_slots). Zero-init BSS; value only meaningful after a winning candidate is recorded for the current AI turn.
notes: Data address (no function); get_plate_comment MCP fails for data, read plate via run_script_inline (was NULL/empty -> created concise plate from src conclusion). Memory @0x53C3F = 16 zero bytes (BSS). xrefs: WRITE @0x15823 (fd2_ai_score_item_use), READ @0x1507C and @0x152E9 (fd2_execute_ai_item_use) -> game-side writer exists, so non-const. src comment (btl_aisc.c lines 660-666) already precise/accurate/ASCII -> kept, btl_aisc.c NOT modified. Other refiners' shard files were already dirty in the worktree; staged only my own shard + (unchanged) btl_aisc.c to avoid sweeping their in-flight work.
